note: Exploratory; read-only; goes into no score.

definitions.hop: a cell is at hop h if its shortest directed path to the MN9 cell has h edges (h=1: direct partner)
definitions.on_sugar_path: shortest hops from the nearest sugar cell + hops to MN9 <= 4
definitions.input_by_hop: signed synapses (weight x sign) on edges from hop-h cells to hop-(h-1) cells (hop 0 = MN9); 'all' = every such cell, 'on_sugar_path' = both ends on a sugar path
definitions.norm_weight: synapses / the postsynaptic cell's total signed input (at or above the floor)
definitions.path_score: product of norm_weight along the path; sign = product of edge signs
definitions.top_paths: exact top 10 simple paths of 1-4 hops from any sugar cell to the MN9 cell, by path_score
definitions.shortest_paths_top25: the strongest 25 paths of exactly the shortest length (all of them if fewer)
definitions.direct_input_by_partner_sugar_distance: MN9's direct partners grouped by their hops from the nearest sugar cell (0 = a sugar cell itself)
